text:
anya.design: Heads-up: during usability testing the batch vectors preview export name is confusing. Users saw 'vectors_export' and couldn't tell which dataset version it was. Also keyboard tab order jumps from table to help link, skipping the export dropdown. Can we review?
joel.pm: thanks. do we want timestamp in filename or dataset slug?
mike.fe: easy to add timestamp + dataset slug. Proposed pattern: {project}-{dataset}-{YYYYMMDD}-{count}.csv e.g., redwood-infer-sales-20260312-42.csv
anya.design: that feels much clearer. Also request: change visible export button text to 'Download CSV' and show the filename in a tooltip on hover/focus.
rita.a11y: accessibility notes: 1) button tooltip must be accessible via focus (aria-describedby), 2) update file name announcement via live region when export completes: "Download ready: redwood-infer-sales-20260312-42.csv", 3) fix tab order so export dropdown is in DOM right after table controls.
mike.fe: implemented aria-describedby and a role="status" live region in the prototype. One snag: when export completes we shift focus to the download link; that caused screenreader to re-read the page. Rita, do you prefer focus move or only announcement?
rita.a11y: move focus to the download link is preferred so keyboard users can immediately activate it, but do it only after the live region announcement to avoid duplicate reads. Also ensure we set aria-atomic on the region.
joel.pm: copy tweak: Update help text under table to 'Export format: CSV. Filenames include project, dataset, date, and row count.' and inline link to doc with CSV format details.
anya.design: layout nits: in slim preview mode the export button collapses to icon only. Suggest that on small widths we show truncated filename in a tooltip and keep a larger touch target for export.
mike.fe: I'll make the touch target 44px min and keep icon-only visual, but expose the filename on long-press/keyboard focus.
rita.a11y: ensure icon-only button has aria-label that includes action and file count, e.g., 'Download CSV, 42 rows'.
bot-ci: export-smoke-tests: csv-filename-pattern -> OK, keyboard-tab-order-check -> WARN (export dropdown after help link)
anya.design: thanks everyone. Mike, can you push a PR with filename pattern + aria/live region changes? Joel, can you update the copy in Figma? Rita will verify after PR. Aim to ship in next minor.
mike.fe: yep, PR later today.
joel.pm: will update Figma and add a note about compact mode behavior.
rita.a11y: I'll run keyboard + VO checks after the PR. If anything else pops up I'll post here.
anya.design: cheers!
